facts.text: Sterling College is one of ten federally recognized Work Colleges in the United States, requiring all students to work 80 hours per semester to reduce tuition costs while gaining hands-on practical skills.

sources.title: Financial Aid — Sterling College Vermont
sources.quote: We are only one of ten Work Colleges in the nation. All students are expected to contribute 80 hours each semester in a job that fits their skillset, allowing them to gain experience and build their resume.
